source: OpenF1 API car_data + location + laps + stints (api.openf1.org/v1)

processing.distance: trapezoidal integral of speed over time from lap start (OpenF1 has no distance channel); across a car_data dropout longer than 1.5 s the increment is the X/Y arc length instead
processing.dropout_rule: car_data samples with throttle > 100 or brake not in {0,100}, and runs of 3+ identical (speed, rpm, throttle, gear) samples after the first, are dropped; where the remaining samples are more than 1.5 s apart the speed/throttle/brake/gear/rpm grid values are null
processing.interpolation: speed/throttle/rpm/x/y linear in time; brake/gear/drs zero-order hold
processing.raw_car_data: the un-interpolated OpenF1 car_data samples inside the lap (brake 0/100 as sent)
processing.xy_units: metres (OpenF1 x/y divided by 10), F1 timing frame
processing.drs: absent: OpenF1 drs field null for every sample of this lap
